sections.changelog: v1.2.102: Finished the Studio polish pass by fixing Plugin Studio and CSS Studio centering rules, adding Plugin Studio outside-click behavior, replacing remaining native Settings and Modules checkboxes with MV-styled controls, and adding a lightweight Bricks media-control bridge that opens Media Studio from common image/media controls. Includes the v1.2.101 Studio, Media Studio, Content Studio, Plugin Studio, CSS Studio, and shortcut rail fixes.
